text:
Maya Patel: Quick help — candidate for Staff SWE (GH #1234) has a timezone conflict. Panel is scheduled Tue 10:00am PT but candidate can only do 1:00pm PT. Can someone swap or cover debrief? Need scribe + lead.
Priya Nair: I’m on PTO Tue morning, but I can cover 1:00pm PT if we move.
Ethan Chen: I can move my calendar. Sam — can you lead the debrief if we shift?
Sam Rodriguez: I can lead debrief + scribe if needed. What rubric are we using?
Maya Patel: Use the Staff SWE rubric (product-systems weighting). Link: https://intranet.company/hiring/rubrics/staff-swe-v2 — please follow the scoring anchors. Also can we shorten the debrief to 20m? Candidate has back-to-back.
Ethan Chen: 20m is OK if we tighten questions. I’ll trim the behavioral to 10m. Update eval weights quickly: 
```
technical: 70
design: 20
behavioral: 10
```
Priya Nair: :thumbsup: I’ll accept the new invite once GH is updated. Maya — can you update the Greenhouse interview slot?
Maya Patel: On it. @ops-bot please create Zoom link and send consent email to candidate.
ops-bot: Automated note — consent email sent to candidate@example.com; Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (passcode in GH). Calendar invites updated for Maya, Priya, Ethan, Sam. Reminder scheduled 24h before.
Priya Nair: Got it, thanks.
Sam Rodriguez: I’ll take notes and lead scoring. Will add the three anchor prompts to the doc.
Maya Patel: Awesome — closing the loop: panel = Maya, Priya, Ethan, Sam. Scribe/debrief lead = Sam. GH slot moved to Tue 1:00pm PT, zoom + consent done. If anyone sees issues reply here, otherwise we’re good. :white_check_mark:
